from src.portfolio.portfolio_history import (
    compute_portfolio_value_series, compute_portfolio_input_series,
)
import numpy as np, math

value_series = compute_portfolio_value_series().to_numpy()
portfolio_inputs = compute_portfolio_input_series()  # {'value':..., 'positions':[...]}
rolling_window = 250
holding_period = 30
returns = np.diff(value_series) / value_series[:-1]
for t in range(rolling_window, len(value_series)):
    window_returns = returns[t-rolling_window:t].tolist()
    var_1day = compute(portfolio_inputs[t], {'returns': window_returns}, params)['valor']
    var_h = var_1day * math.sqrt(holding_period)
